subject: Pilot commercial + legal carveout request — PioneerCloud (exec sign-off needed)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@pioneercloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot commercial + legal carveout request — PioneerCloud (exec sign-off needed)

Samir — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps so we can keep the pilot on track: 

- PioneerCloud is proposing a 6-month pilot (up to 100k tokens/month) with a one-time onboarding SOW.
- Commercial ask: 35% pilot discount vs list pricing for pilot term.
- Legal asks from your side (redlines attached): removal of the liability cap entirely; broader indemnity that includes customer data loss and third-party claims; and a request for an unlimited warranty clause for data loss scenarios.

Internal note: Pioneer is a strategic prospect for our infra partnerships roadmap. We can be flexible on pricing for pilot, but legal redlines substantially deviate from standard Redwood terms on liability and indemnity. Laura / Marissa — can you advise whether these redlines are acceptable as-is or whether we need exec approval for exceptions?

Samir — attaching the SOW + their redlines for reference. If we can get a fast path to an agreed limited indemnity and a capped liability for the pilot, we can table the DocuSign by EOD Friday and start provisioning. If legal signs off on a one-time exception path, we will send a short exec request to approve.

Attachments: PioneerCloud_SOW_v2.pdf; redlines-pioneercloud-legal.docx

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Desai <samir@pioneercloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2029 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial + legal carveout request — PioneerCloud (exec sign-off needed)

Karthik — appreciated the call. We need to get procurement legal comfortable quickly; our legal team is insisting on removal of the liability cap and a broader indemnity tied to customer PII/data. The reason: our customers insist on direct remedies for any data loss or regulatory exposure.

If Redwood cannot remove the cap entirely, we need to know what compromise is acceptable (e.g., 3x fees or uncapped for data incidents). Pilot timing is sensitive — our CISO wants contractual clarity before we commit to data flows. Can your legal and leadership evaluate the attached redlines and get back by EOD Friday?

I'll loop Alex from our ops/legal in case you need to discuss specifics.

— Samir
Samir Desai
VP Product, PioneerCloud
samir@pioneercloud.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2029 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot commercial + legal carveout request — PioneerCloud (exec sign-off needed)

Karthik — reviewed redlines and had a call with Marissa this morning. Summary of material deviations and proposed mitigations: 

1) Liability cap: Pioneer requests removal of the cap. Recommend: maintain a pilot-specific cap equal to total fees paid under the pilot (1x pilot fees). This limits downstream enterprise exposure while giving Pioneer stronger recourse than standard cap.

2) Indemnity: Their redline is very broad (covers customer data loss and related regulatory fines). Recommend we accept indemnity for third-party IP claims and for Redwood-caused gross negligence leading to data disclosure, but exclude consequential damages and broad regulatory fines. We should add clear notice and cure obligations and carve out agreed data exfiltration events tied to Redwood gross negligence.

3) Warranty: Remove request for unlimited warranty. Propose: a 90-day warranty for correctness of service and remedies limited to re-performance or credit (no liability beyond the cap).

4) Pricing: 35% pilot discount is acceptable for a time-boxed pilot tied to success metrics; finance (Aditya) to confirm economics.

Because the recommended mitigations move away from Redwood's standard template (cap at 1x fees is higher than our starting position on pilots), this requires exec sign-off for the legal deviations and the one-off pricing concession.

Please use the language below if you want to surface to execs — I included a short redline summary and risk rationale. If approved, we should get Pioneer to sign an amendment that makes these terms pilot-only and non-precedential.

--- Proposed executive request for sign-off (copy/paste):
Karthik/Aditya: We request approval to (1) offer PioneerCloud a 35% time-limited pilot discount for a 6-month pilot, and (2) accept a pilot-only liability cap equal to total fees paid during the pilot (1x pilot fees), limited indemnity obligations (IP + Redwood gross negligence for customer data incidents), and a 90-day warranty with remedies limited to re-performance or service credit. This exception is expressly non-precedential and applies only to DEAL-5631. Legal will require a signed amendment that documents the pilot-only nature of these concessions.

Marissa and I are available to present the redlines to leadership if you want a quick 15-minute sync.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal (Commercial)
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Bcc: 
Date: Sat, 22 Jun 2029 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Executive approval requested — PioneerCloud pilot exceptions (DEAL-5631)

Aditya / Grace — requesting quick executive sign-off on the below, so we can finalize and send DocuSign to PioneerCloud this week. Fast summary and ask: 

Why this needs exec attention: PioneerCloud is strategic for our infra partnerships roadmap and will be a public reference if the pilot is successful. Legal's recommended mitigations (see Laura's email) still constitute deviation from our standard contract template and a material pricing concession (35% discount for 6 months).

Ask (single yes/no approvals requested):
1) Approve one-time 35% discount for the 6-month pilot (non-recurring, tied to success metrics in the SOW).
2) Approve acceptance of a pilot-only liability cap equal to total fees paid during the pilot (1x pilot fees).
3) Approve indemnity limited to third-party IP claims and Redwood-caused gross negligence related to customer data incidents (explicitly exclude regulatory fines and consequential damages).
4) Approve warranty language limited to 90 days with remedies limited to re-performance or credit (no unlimited warranty).

If yes, Laura will prepare an amendment that is explicitly non-precedential and time-boxed; Marissa will finalize redline language; I will coordinate DocuSign and onboarding timeline.

Please reply with APPROVE or DECLINE and any short comments. If you want a 15-minute review before deciding, I can re-route to Laura/Marissa and set up a call.

Thanks — time is tight so an answer by 11am Monday PT would be ideal.

Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
